refactor(examples): rich-dash and claude-sessions run on App; the dashboard runtime is gone (rich-runtime-fna.5) (#208)

* refactor(examples): rich-dash and claude-sessions run on App; the dashboard runtime is gone (rich-runtime-fna.5)

Every full-screen demo now takes the terminal through App: none of them
enters the alternate screen, sets raw mode or tears either down itself.

- rich-dash: DashboardRuntime (Live + setInterval + stop) is deleted. The
  demo body owns only its clock; App owns the terminal. A widget with no
  layout cell now fails at startup instead of silently never drawing, and
  q / Esc / Ctrl+C quit and Ctrl+Z suspends — raw mode made Ctrl+C a key,
  so the entry's SIGINT/SIGTERM handlers go too.
- claude-sessions: Live + setRawMode + cleanup replaced by App; Ctrl+Z
  suspends. The status bar escapes its hint keys, so the `\` hint no
  longer swallows its closing tag.
- The browser wires stop calling host.start(): App starts the host.

* fix(examples): stopping a demo stops its app; App.fail ends an app with an error (rich-runtime-fna.5)

Review round (high):
- App.fail(error) ends the app and rejects run with that error; WidgetApp
  forwards it. The three demos' captured-failure slots are gone.
- run() in rich-dash, claude-sessions and rich-explore returns { done, stop },
  and each browser MountHandle.stop stops the app. rich-dash's clock no
  longer outlives a stopped mount.
- claude-sessions repaints only on a change of state, so pointer motion on
  the alternate screen paints nothing. Its search-typing keymap passes
  Ctrl+C and Ctrl+Z through.
- rich-dash no longer quits on a bare ESC, which a split escape sequence
  also delivers.
- The rich-dash browser README fixture names run(), not runDemo().

* fix(rich-dash): the first tick runs before any input is subscribed (rich-runtime-fna.5)

fix(table): draw with Table.style and Column's three styles, as the reference does (rich-table-jph)

Table.style is the base the border style layers over; a column's headerStyle and
footerStyle layer over the table's, and its style sits under the row's rowStyles
entry. The cell's style now covers its padding and the blank lines a short cell
runs out of, which is where the reference puts it. Each case is pinned against
Python Rich 9d8f9a3's bytes.
